desc:
Childhood memories of games: Cops & Robbers!
Become a police officer and a thief and engage in thrilling chases!

How to play:
👮 Police
Catch the thief, put handcuffs on him, and transport him to prison!
Prevent the thief from stealing all the items within the time limit!
Repair the iron cage to prevent escapes and rescues! 🔧

💰 Thief
Use a crowbar to break things and steal them!
Win by stealing all items within the time limit and surviving!
Break the iron cage and rescue your trapped friend!

⚡ Crouch and use your skills to win chase battles!
🎨 Collect various crowbar and police baton skins to create your own unique style!

🎮 It's even more fun with friends!
👍 Like the game and join the group!
